items.title: Heathrow and Other European Airports Hit by Cyberattack, Several Flights Delayed

items.description: AI-powered malware, known as ‘MalTerminal’, uses OpenAI’s GPT-4 model to dynamically generate malicious code, including ransomware and reverse shells, marking a significant shift in how threats are developed and deployed.
